title: Semester Storage Estimator
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Learning Analytics
xAPI
LRS-Lite
Browser Storage
description: Calculate a semester's xAPI statement count and LRS-Lite storage footprint from daily activity assumptions, then judge the headroom left under the 10 MB budget in Summary and Full mode.
audience: Teachers, instructional designers, learning-technology developers and learning-analytics practitioners (college undergraduate and professional development)

educational.topic: LRS-Lite statement volume and size estimates
learningObjectives: The learner will calculate the statement count and storage footprint of a semester from activity assumptions, and judge how much headroom remains under a 10 MB limit.

accessibility.notes: Native range inputs and buttons; canvas has an aria-label; readout is an aria-live region.

controls.label: Load design cases
controls.action: Cycle through the four measured cases from the chapter table

keyQuestions: How many statements does a typical semester produce in Summary mode?
How much headroom remains under 10 MB?
Which lever changes the footprint most: mode, drags or days?
commonMisconceptions: That the 10 MB budget is a tight working constraint for a summary-mode pilot
That Full mode and the Full LRS are the same thing
assessmentOpportunities: Compute statements per semester by hand and compare with the readout
Explain the gap between modelled and measured gzip size for Full mode

assumptions: 980 bytes per statement (design measurement on synthetic statements)
limitations: Figures are modelled from synthetic statements, not real learners
Measured gzip ratios for Full mode are about 15-17x, so the model overstates Full-mode gzip size
